title: Agent Enumeration Lab
summary: Bouch's research and evidence layer for agent standards, harnesses, MCP, Skills, plugins, protocols and domain knowledge. Consult before researching a standard or ecosystem from scratch: source records pin what was inspected and when, findings carry lifecycle status (ENUMERATED, VALIDATED, PROMOTED), and probes hold the real validator and CLI runs behind each claim. Includes the standards fit behind this registry and an evidence-tiered audio capability map showing which production areas are proven and which are gaps.
